templates.title: Immich
templates.name: immich
templates.description: Self-hosted photo and video backup with machine learning search.

env.name: UPLOAD_LOCATION
env.label: Photo/video upload path on Docker host

env.name: DB_DATA_LOCATION
env.label: PostgreSQL data path on Docker host

templates.note: Uses host bind mounts for media and database data. Set a real DB_PASSWORD before deploying. Exposes Immich on port 2283.

templates.title: Nginx Proxy Manager
templates.name: nginx-proxy-manager
templates.description: Reverse proxy manager with a web UI and Let's Encrypt certificate management.
templates.note: Publishes ports 80, 443, and 81. Do not deploy another service that binds 80/443 on the same host.

templates.title: Glance
templates.name: glance
templates.description: Self-hosted personal dashboard with RSS, videos, weather, markets, releases, and community widgets.
templates.note: Uses the Glance config committed under portainer/templates/stacks/glance/config. Exposes the dashboard on port 8080.
